notes: Open subset: Weighted O/D points for the SF routing benchmark sampler, built from public OpenStreetMap and LODES data. Weights are comparable only within a category; mix categories with 'purposes' (shares are assumptions, not measurements). Home and job points are LODES block counts summed over ~1.4 km cells. OSM places other than transit stations, beaches, trailheads and bike shops are counted per category over ~1.4 km cells: the point is the cell's heaviest named place, the weight the cell's sum and the subcategory says how many places it stands for. Generated by build_sf.py.
attribution: Contains data from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright) and US Census LEHD LODES 8, 2023 (public domain).

civic.description: OSM library, post office, town hall, community centre, hospital, clinic.

food.description: OSM restaurants, cafes, fast food, bars and ice cream.

home.description: LODES RAC 2023 resident workers (all jobs), summed over ~1.4 km cells (100 or more); the point is the cell's largest block.

lodging.description: OSM hotels, motels, hostels, guest houses and campsites; weight = rooms/capacity tag or a type default.

park.description: OSM named parks and marinas; weight 1 + area/2 (ha, capped 20).

school.description: OSM schools, colleges and universities; weight by level heuristic (no enrollment data).

shop.description: OSM hardware, department, sports and bakery shops.

transit.description: OSM rail stations and ferry terminals: BART, Caltrain, Amtrak, SMART and ferries weight 3, light rail and other stations 1.

work.description: LODES WAC 2023 jobs, summed over ~1.4 km cells (100 or more); the point is the cell's largest block. Excludes self-employed.
